instruction.text: Find the examples of electricity being used in the paragraph.

atoms.b: Devi is getting ready for school. Firstly, ((she uses_the_toaster_to_make_herself_some_toast.)) Then, she uses her manual toothbrush to brush her teeth. On the way to school, ((she_uses_her_phone_to_call_her_friend)).
When Devi arrives at school, she takes her books out of her bag. At lunchtime, she goes to the library and ((turns_on_the_desk_lamp)) because it is too dark to see.

instruction.text: Find all the items that need electricity to work.

atoms.a: How was Devi able to use her phone while walking to school?
b: she took a plug with her

instruction.text: Find all the items that are battery operated.

feedback.end: Batteries are used as a source of power in things that need to be portable, such as phones, torches and smartwatches.

trainers.instruction: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

feedback.end: The batteries in phones are rechargeable and can be plugged into an electrical socket to be charged.

atoms.a: All batteries are the same size.
All batteries have the same capacity.

feedback.end: Batteries can hold different amounts of power. For example, electronic toys use smaller, low capacity batteries, whereas electronic bikes use larger batteries because they need more power to operate.
